items.meaning_mnemonic: Picture a hooded figure crouched low to the <radical>earth</radical> behind the enormous bell at Grandma Kane's shrine at dusk. Nothing about him adds up — the hood, the hovering hand, the flinching at cats. That unexplained wrongness is what <kanji>suspicious</kanji> means.
items.reading_mnemonic: The figure only gives his name as <reading>Kai</reading>, and when Grandma Kane flicks on the shrine lights without warning he yelps <reading>かい</reading> and bolts past the mossy steps, offering box completely untouched.
items.description: 怪 carries more than a raised eyebrow of doubt — it's the character behind monsters, ghost stories, and the eerie unknown, so think uncanny and unexplained before you think of doubting someone's alibi.
